title: Foo Bar Local Query Benchmark
description: Optimize a local ClickHouse benchmark workload so three seeded dashboard queries meet latency targets without changing their answers.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must speed up a local ClickHouse benchmark by improving query performance without changing the benchmark results.

tasks.description: Use the local benchmark assets in /workspace/benchmarks to reduce query latency for the seeded workload while preserving all results.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse is running locally with a 6M-row analytics.events_local table stored in a poor sort order. Local benchmark queries and a runner are seeded into /workspace/benchmarks.
